metadata.query: SELECT g.source_id, g.designation, g.ref_epoch, g.ra, g.dec, g.ra_error, g.dec_error, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.parallax_over_error, g.pmra, g.pmra_error, g.pmdec, g.pmdec_error, g.radial_velocity, g.radial_velocity_error, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.phot_bp_mean_mag, g.phot_rp_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, g.ruwe, g.duplicated_source, g.astrometric_params_solved, g.in_qso_candidates, g.in_galaxy_candidates, h.original_ext_source_id AS hip_original_ext_source_id, h.angular_distance AS hip_angular_distance, h.number_of_neighbours AS hip_number_of_neighbours, h.xm_flag AS hip_xm_flag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour AS h ON g.source_id = h.source_id WHERE g.phot_g_mean_mag <= 6 ORDER BY g.source_id, h.original_ext_source_id
metadata.countQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g WHERE g.phot_g_mean_mag <= 6
metadata.verification: Successful VOTable QUERY_STATUS and distinct-source count equal to independent ESA COUNT
limitations: Magnitude-limited browser subset, not the full Gaia DR3 catalogue or a complete inventory of bright stars.
Native Gaia measurements do not overwrite NASA/Hipparcos or Johnson V measurements.
No distance inversion or parallax zero-point correction is applied by this importer.
An official best neighbour is evidence of association, not proof of physical identity; ambiguity flags are retained.
